preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call issue() function
Attacker must have some initial USDT balance to demonstrate the accounting issue

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the issue() function with a large amount to mint new USDT tokens to the owner's balance without proper collateral validation. This exploits the missing check that should verify collateral tokens before allowing investment/minting. The owner can arbitrarily increase their balance by calling issue(amount) repeatedly.
